## The Invisible AI Layer

Ambient computing refers to AI that runs in the background and assists work without explicit commands. Enterprise software vendors have been adding this kind of assistance to everyday tools. This article quotes no adoption figures, because we have not cited a source for any.

### Where Ambient AI Shows Up

| Application | What it does |
|---|---|
| Meeting summarization | Generates notes and action items |
| Email drafting | Suggests replies based on context |
| Code completion | Writes boilerplate and suggests structure |
| Sales coaching | Offers guidance during or after calls |
| Document analysis | Extracts key data from contracts and reports |

### Impact on Job Requirements

Job descriptions need a review. Skills that matter less as tools take over routine work:

- Manual note-taking and documentation
- Basic data entry and formatting
- Routine research and information gathering
- Template-based content creation

Skills that matter more:

- Using AI tools well and checking their output
- Creative and strategic thinking
- Cross-functional collaboration
- Ethical judgment in AI-assisted decisions

### How to Hire for an Ambient AI World

- **Test AI fluency:** ask candidates how they use AI tools in their current workflow.
- **Evaluate judgment:** when AI handles routine tasks, judgment on exceptions becomes the differentiator.
- **Prioritise adaptability:** tools change often, so hire people who learn quickly.
- **Update job descriptions:** remove tasks that tools handle and add the oversight and strategic skills that matter.
